description: Open NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software and load the default 'Sample House' project (if not already loaded). Navigate to the Living Room area. Identify the standard flat window on the exterior wall of the living room. Delete this existing window, then replace it with a 'Bay Window' from the Windows library. Ensure the new window projects outward correctly. Finally, save the modified project as 'RenovatedBayWindow.dpp' in the 'Documents\DreamPlan' folder.
